title: Replace Indomills logo asset with uploaded version (solid background, crisp)

requirements.summary: Update the existing generated logo asset so Header and Footer render the newly uploaded Indomills logo with a clean single-color background and crisp edges, without changing any code paths or UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Header logo and Footer logo both display the updated logo using the existing path /assets/generated/indomills-logo.dim_512x256.png (no code-path changes needed).
The exported logo has a uniform single-color background (no transparency checkerboard, fringing, or rough edges).
The logo appears crisp (not blurry) on mobile and desktop at the current rendered sizes (Header h-9/h-11; Footer h-12).
No other UI sections, navigation, routes, CTAs, or copy are modified.

file_operations.description: Replace the current logo file with a freshly exported 512x256 image derived from 1000066378-removebg-preview.png, ensuring a uniform single-color (non-transparent) background, clean anti-aliased edges/no fringing, and appropriate padding so it stays sharp at the current Header/Footer rendered sizes; keep the filename and location exactly the same to preserve the existing /assets/generated/indomills-logo.dim_512x256.png src path usage.
